sections.h2: 1. Buy the treatment as a 2 pack
parts: One bottle of the keratin treatment is £37.90; the 2 pack is £68.90, which is £34.45 a bottle. With {code} the 2 pack comes to about £58.57, or about £29.28 a bottle. ANSWR says one application lasts up to three months, so a 2 pack covers about half a year by the brand's own count.

figure.alt: ANSWR at-home keratin treatment kit with the treatment bottle, post-treatment shampoo and conditioner

sections.h2: 2. Compare the subscription with the code
parts: The store sells the keratin treatment on a subscription for £29.90 a bottle instead of £37.90 (20% off), delivered every 2 or 3 months, and the kit on a 3-month subscription for £39.90 instead of £49.90. Shopify stores often don't let a discount code stack with a subscription price, so add both to the cart and keep the lower total: on a single bottle, the subscription (£29.90) is cheaper than the one-off price with {code} (£32.22).
Read the subscription terms at checkout before you agree; the store's refund policy says you can cancel once the cost of the kit is covered.

sections.h2: 3. Take the kit instead of buying shampoo separately
parts: The kit (£49.90) holds 100ml each of the treatment, the post-treatment shampoo and the conditioner. Bought on their own, the treatment and the 300ml shampoo and conditioner bundle come to £77.80, though the bundle bottles are three times larger. If you only want to try the routine once, the kit is the cheaper start: about £42.42 with {code}.

ANSWR says orders usually leave its UK warehouse within 24 hours and arrive in 2 to 3 business days. Royal Mail tracked standard was £3.90 for one bottle and still £3.90 for two; we didn't see a free-delivery threshold. EU orders ship from the Netherlands in 4 to 8 business days, and the rest of the world takes 7 to 10, where duties may apply.

Its refund policy offers a 30-day money-back guarantee: you email the brand, and refunds are processed once the products are back, within 30 days of purchase. You pay the return postage unless the item arrived damaged, in which case ANSWR replaces it and covers the return. Our [ANSWR review](saving-tips-answr-review.html) sums up the ratings and the complaints.
